notes: Scrapper Clans "Thunderknuckle", a hull mount (outward is up): the 4x3 housing: four mismatched nozzles welded into a fist (a grey pipe, a rust cone, a steel box, a taped stovepipe at different heights) on a palm of mismatched bolted plates with a weld across the top and a band of hazard tape; inside the Kickjet core with a crude painted fist, two motors, heavy tape and patches. Damaged: the stovepipe is bent and sputters, the box nozzle is cracked, tape is peeling off the palm, a plate lost its bolts, sparks. Disabled: the stovepipe snapped off, the cone bent over, the pipe hanging off its weld, the palm plates split, the core dead. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
